title: Charlotte 49ers announce timeline to purchase tickets for football game against Bill Belichick and the Tar Heels - NewsBreak
text: CHARLOTTE, N.C. (CAROLINA SPORTS LIVE) — Given the high demand for the Charlotte 49ers’ matchup against UNC this fall, the athletic department has announced a timeline for the football game’s ticket priority. The Tar Heels travel to the Queen City Sept. 6, taking on the 49ers at Jerry Richardson Stadium, a facility that holds 15,000 people. And Charlotte is expecting a full house to watch the first college team led by six-time Super Bowl winning head coach Bill Belichick. Here is the order for ticket allotment: July 29: Season ticket holders and 49er Club members will have the first opportunity to purchase single-game tickets. The exclusive presale offer will be sent to current football season ticket holders and 49er Club members the same day, and to UNC Charlotte alumni on July 30. Aug. 5: Any remaining tickets will be released to the general public. Ticket availability is expected to be limited and is subject to dynamic pricing. With season tickets sold out, the best way for fans to guarantee access to the North Carolina game is by purchasing a 3-Game Flex Plan. The game will be available to stream on ESPN+. It will be Charlotte’s second game under new head coach Tim Albin. The 49ers also said there are limited tickets remaining for the season opener on Aug. 29 against App State at Bank of America Stadium, as well as for the Family Weekend & Hall of Fame game against Monmouth on Sept. 13. An expansion of Jerry Richardson is planned to break ground in 2025. It will include additional seating, including suits, plus loge boxes, ledge seating, an indoor club and deck patio space. Belichick will also be Charlotte this week for ACC Kickoff in uptown. For the latest news, weather, sports, and streaming video, head to Queen City News.
